mapper.sql: SELECT E.EXECUTION_ID, E.QUERY_ID, E.BATCH_ID, E.STATUS, E.STARTED_AT, E.DURATION_MS, B.REQUESTED_AT, R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.TITLE AS REQUEST_TITLE, I.QUERY_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY E.QUERY_ID ORDER BY B.REQUESTED_AT DESC NULLS LAST, B.BATCH_ID DESC, E.EXECUTION_ID DESC ) AS LATEST_RANK FROM QUERY_EXECUTION E JOIN EXECUTION_BATCH B ON B.BATCH_ID = E.BATCH_ID JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = B.REQUEST_ID JOIN QUERY_ITEM I ON I.QUERY_ID = E.QUERY_ID AND I.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID WHERE R.DRAFTER_ID = #{drafterId}

SELECT E.EXECUTION_ID, E.QUERY_ID, E.REQUEST_ID, E.REQUEST_NO, E.REQUEST_TITLE, E.QUERY_TITLE, E.BATCH_ID, E.STATUS, F.ROW_COUNT, E.REQUESTED_AT, E.STARTED_AT, E.DURATION_MS FROM (
) E LEFT JOIN ( SELECT EXECUTION_ID, ROW_COUNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY EXECUTION_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, RESULT_ID DESC ) AS RESULT_RANK FROM QUERY_RESULT ) F ON F.EXECUTION_ID = E.EXECUTION_ID AND F.RESULT_RANK = 1 WHERE E.LATEST_RANK = 1 ORDER BY E.REQUESTED_AT DESC NULLS LAST, E.BATCH_ID DESC, E.EXECUTION_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
